title: Identification of 10,000-year-old rice beer at Shangshan in the Lower Yangzi River valley of China
lineage: Original study with a partially overlapping research group and a distinct site and specimen assemblage.

passages.note: Globular jars from the early Shangshan phase, circa 10,000–9,000 cal BP, yield rice and fungal microfossils interpreted as rice beer made with a mould starter.
